Title: Call recording for Azure Communication Services coming soon

Body.Content:
Call recording for Azure Communication Services is in development. As a built-in platform feature, call recording for Azure Communication Services helps to simplify and improve the recording process by providing secure, server-side runtime control APIs that allow for mixed audio and video output with built-in temporary storage for up to 48 hours. Recorded media output is in MP4 audio+video format, just like in Teams, with more formats like audio-only MP3 planned.
